description: Put a list of a project's terms and claims on other sites under ONE link (PM-1167) — for an article that cites many: the site puts 'script' in once and marks its words by name, <span data-kaiku-term="kernel"> or data-kaiku-claim="thm:d5-rank5", each opening its cloud. Only what the list names goes out, each thing as its own link would show it; a name not on it says so and nothing of the project. The list is given by hand: 'terms' — ids, words or spellings — and 'claims' — ids or labels — comma-separated, each one you may put out alone (a confirmed term you may open); the first that is not is the refusal and nothing is made. At most 200 things a set and 20 sets a project. A set has no card. 'sites' and 'days' as for create_term_embed. Only for somebody who may write in the project; a line in its history.

days.description: Days the link answers, 1 to 3650. Optional: none is until it is removed.

sites.description: Sites that may show it, comma-separated, as https://example.org. Optional: none is any site.

terms.description: Terms, comma-separated: ids, words or spellings.

title.description: The set's name, e.g. the article's; up to 120 characters. Optional.

name: create_embed_set
title: Create embed set
